iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 4 evening scan: Reuters May 2 reports Iran offered Hormuz/shipping relief while deferring nuclear talks; Trump rejected the proposal while repeating Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon. No confirmed 90% enrichment, nuclear test, or IAEA emergency today. Risk remains high because nuclear diplomacy is sequenced behind a live Iran/Hormuz crisis rather than resolved. Probability 58%. Stable/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 4 evening scan: Reuters May 2 reports Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz/end the war before later nuclear talks; Reuters Apr 29-30 still shows Hormuz traffic at a trickle and the US naval blockade squeezing Iran oil exports. Chokepoint crisis remains unresolved; no de-escalatory implementation confirmed. Probability 78%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 4 evening scan: Al Jazeera May 3 reports Israel issued new forced-displacement orders covering more than 10 southern Lebanon towns/villages, including north of the Litani, followed by strikes despite the US-brokered ceasefire. Ceasefire degradation is active and operationally visible. Probability 84%. Rising/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 4 evening scan: no fresh Turkey kinetic trigger found. Search results emphasize Ankara's NATO/Ukraine/Iran mediation and Syria posture rather than direct escalation. Turkey remains a secondary spillover/alliance node, not a primary nuclear-escalation driver this cycle. Probability 20%. Falling/elevated.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 4 evening scan: no reliable fresh India-Pakistan escalation item surfaced; Reuters results remain dominated by stale 2025 Kashmir and cross-border escalation reporting. No new mobilization, missile exchange, or official nuclear rhetoric detected. Probability 8%. Falling/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: May 4 evening scan: no new Russian nuclear alert change detected. Reuters Apr 21-23 remains the active signal set: NATO criticized Russian nuclear rhetoric and Moscow warned European states hosting French nuclear-capable bombers would become priority targets. Elevated but not newly spiking. Probability 38%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China
china.notes: May 4 evening scan: China-Taiwan risk remains high on normalization of PLA air/naval activity and recent blockade-style drills, but the fresh scan did not confirm a new May invasion/blockade trigger. Risk remains imminent by posture, slightly lower absent fresh kinetic signal. Probability 60%. Falling/imminent.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 4 evening scan: no fresh May launch detected after the Apr 19-20 missile-test cluster. Reuters/KCNA reported Kim oversaw upgraded short-range ballistic missiles with cluster/fragmentation warheads; Al Jazeera noted the seventh ballistic launch of 2026/fourth in April and irreversible nuclear-state rhetoric. Signal decays but remains critical. Probability 44%. Falling/critical.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 4 evening scan: BBC/Reuters results show ceasefire efforts stalling while Russia conducts large drone/missile strike cycles and Ukraine continues deep strikes on Russian energy infrastructure. Putin/Trump ceasefire talk has not stopped the widening strike-counterstrike pattern. Probability 60%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 4 evening scan: Al Jazeera Apr 28 reports the Afghan-Pakistan truce under strain after a strike on a university/residential areas in Kunar killed at least seven and wounded more than 80; prior Reuters Feb 26 confirmed Taliban retaliatory attacks and Pakistani-Afghan border clashes. Not a nuclear track directly, but a renewed border-conflict tail risk. Probability 28%. Rising/critical.
